definitions: A legal process by which a monetary judgment against a debtor is satisfied in part or in full out of money or property belonging to the debtor but in the possession of a third party (such as an employer or bank).
The act of garnishing wages or property.
Something that garnishes; an embellishment or a decoration.
examples: The court ordered a wage garnishment.
The bank received a garnishment notice.
The chef added a colorful garnishment to the dish.
